Name: Crab Pot Fish Variety
Author: WhyBother11
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52901/52901-1790358768-6180375.png[/img][/center]
This mod features:
[list]
[*]4 new crab pot fish, exclusive to desert. With this mod installed, only these fish may appear in crab pots here.[/*]
[*]2 new crab pot fish in Secret Woods, 2 new crab pot fish in Sewers with one of them appearing in Mutant Bug's Lair as well, extra 2 new crab pot fish in Mutant Bug's Lair and 1 new crab pot fish in Witch's Swamp.[/*]
[*]All added fish have fish pond data and aquarium sprites.[/*]
[/list][size=5]Compatibility[/size]
(Should be) Compatible with any mod, including expansions and fishing mods, mods adding other location specific crab pot fish, like in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18109]Distant Lands[/url].
If you have issues with catching certain crab pot fish, be it from this or other mod, I highly recommend checking out my another [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53069]mod[/url].

[size=5]Installation[/size]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*](Optionally) Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game config menu.[/*]
[*]Download the mod and extract it into StardewValley/Mods. [/*]
[/list]Source code is available [url=https://github.com/WhyBother11/CrabPotFishVariety]here[/url].

[size=5]Config[/size]
[list]
[*]Allow Vanilla Crab Pot Fish: whether vanilla crab pot fish should spawn in certain affected locations (currently desert).[/*]
[/list][size=5]Translations[/size]
Currently includes English and Russian translations (both will be kept up to date with any updates). All additional translations are welcome, so long as they contain only i18n files, here they are:
[list=1]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52928]Vietnamese[/url] translation by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Fishlovers]Fishlovers[/url][/*]
[/list]
